bio.text: Marcela Mitaynes represents Assembly District 51 in Brooklyn, covering Red Hook, Sunset Park and northern Bay Ridge.
According to her official biography, she migrated to New York City from Peru as a child and was raised in Sunset Park, where she is raising her own family.
She served as president of the PTA at P.S. 169, was a member of Community Board 7 for 10 years, and worked as a tenant organizer with Neighbors Helping Neighbors.
